children: Public Storage entered into an underwriting agreement for a C$400 million offering of 4.540% senior notes due 2033, to be issued by PS Canada Finance ULC and guaranteed by Public Storage and Public Storage Operating Company. The notes, issued at par, pay interest semi-annually on March 16 and September 16, beginning March 16, 2027, with closing expected on September 16, 2026. Net proceeds will replenish cash used for the Public Storage Canada acquisition and support general corporate purposes, including facility investments, debt repayment, and potential redemptions.

: Scotia Capital and TD Securities, as representatives of the underwriters
